0022600027.text: The Cavaliers host the 76ers with Cleveland at 4-4, sixth in the East, second in the Central and 2 games back, on a two-game losing streak. Philadelphia is 8-1, first in the Atlantic and the East, and riding a five-game winning streak. Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), while Jarrett Allen (knee) and Tyrese Proctor (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Adem Bona (head) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Cavaliers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 114-106 in Philadelphia on October 22, but they won the 2025-26 series 4-0.
